name: MD17: Molecular Dynamics Trajectory and Force-Field Dataset
description: MD17 is a benchmark molecular dynamics dataset containing 3,611,118 ab initio molecular configurations of eight small organic molecules (benzene, uracil, naphthalene, aspirin, salicylic acid, malonaldehyde, ethanol, toluene). Generated by Stefan Chmiela, Alexandre Tkatchenko, and collaborators via ab initio molecular dynamics at the DFT/PBE+vdW-TS level, it provides exact atomic coordinates, total energies, and interatomic forces widely benchmarked for energy-conserving machine learning force fields.
